text_block_list.text:
...I just can't settle on a training menu. 
Thinking a breath of fresh air might clear 
my head, I went for a walk—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Turning even the dark southerly winds of 
the heart into an auspicious breeze. 
……Waiting for the wind here truly is a day 
well spent, isn't it?

Though full of unfamiliar terms... drawn 
by the word 'wind,' I look around.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Facing the dry wind head-on... For those 
feeling unwell, it might make breathing 
all the more difficult.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If a blessed breeze is to blow once 
more... then riding upon the wind would be 
most fitting.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Close your eyes, and feel the 
gentle breeze...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...The wind will blow. Over the treetops, 
through the city――

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Brushing against the sea, soaring up into 
the heavens. ...Free to wander... to the 
ends of the earthââ Traveling across 
this vast world...
choice_data_list: To the ends of the earth...

text_block_list.text:
To be free, Yamanin Zephyr gazes up at the 
sky. The vast, boundless world――

What about the world I've been seeing up 
until now? Saying only that was 
acceptable, this was unacceptable... 
Hadn't I narrowed it down all by myself?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...It seems the winds have shifted. The 
ill breeze lingering in the air has turned 
into a bright, gentle draft.

Experiencing the freedom of the wind made 
me realize my thinking had grown rigid. 
This isâ

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The gentle breeze... swells into a gale, 
swirling upward. Such a course, too, is 
providence.

With that said, she departed along with 
the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes. I'm sure the winds that 
follow will be just as auspicious.

And after that, each of them went on to 
enjoy the pleasant breeze in their own 
way.
